excerpt: Stablecoins and tokenised deposits converge around programmable settlement but diverge on balance-sheet, legal, liquidity, and trust models. The 2026 strategic question for banks is design discipline — which money model carries which client workflow — and how to defend deposit franchise, settlement role, and regulated brand against private-issuer competition.
